name: yt-live-chat-overlay
description: Nico-nico style comment overlay for YouTube live chat (100% local processing)

scripts.preinstall: test -f packages/core/package.json || { echo '⚠️  Submodule not initialized. Run: git submodule update --init'; exit 1; }
scripts.quality: pnpm -s fmt && pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s check && pnpm -s check:extension && pnpm -s circular && pnpm -s knip && pnpm -s quality:nose
scripts.quality:ci: pnpm -s fmt && pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s check && pnpm -s check:extension && pnpm -s circular && pnpm -s knip && pnpm -s quality:nose
scripts.quality:fix: pnpm -s fmt:fix && pnpm -s lint:fix && pnpm -s check && pnpm -s circular && pnpm -s knip
scripts.quality:nose: bash -c 'if command -v nose &>/dev/null; then nose query src --baseline .nose-baseline.json --fail-on new; else echo "[nose] not installed — skipping"; fi'
scripts.verify: pnpm -s quality && pnpm build && pnpm build:extension && pnpm build:extension:firefox
scripts.validate:consistency: cd test && npx vitest run consistency/
scripts.prebuild: pnpm -s check-versions && pnpm -s check-i18n && pnpm -s quality
scripts.prebuild:extension: pnpm -s check-versions && pnpm -s check-i18n && pnpm -s quality
scripts.prebuild:extension:firefox: pnpm -s check-versions && pnpm -s check-i18n && pnpm -s quality
scripts.build:extension: pnpm -s prebuild:extension && vite build --config vite.config.extension.ts && vite build --config vite.config.extension.cs.ts && cp extension/manifest.json dist-extension/manifest.json && cp -r extension/icons dist-extension/
scripts.build:extension:dev: vite build --mode development && vite build --config vite.config.extension.cs.ts --mode development && cp extension/manifest.json dist-extension/manifest.json && cp -r extension/icons dist-extension/
scripts.build:extension:firefox: pnpm -s prebuild:extension:firefox && vite build --config vite.config.extension.firefox.ts && vite build --config vite.config.extension.cs.firefox.ts && cp extension/manifest.firefox.json dist-extension-firefox/manifest.json && cp -r extension/icons dist-extension-firefox/

author: PiesP
